name: under-punct-positive
prompt: Humanize this. It's a summary paragraph for a service review.
expected_output: Punctuation scarcity identified as UNDER-PUNCT and fixed: the three long 'and'-chained sentences broken up and given internal punctuation, with every figure preserved. The word-list scan on this text is clean, so the finding must come from the rate measure, not from watch-list hits. Gate case for UNDER-PUNCT, which ships un-thresholded.
expectations: The response identifies punctuation scarcity, long unpunctuated sentences, or 'and' used as a joint between propositions as the primary problem, and names UNDER-PUNCT as a stable ID in uppercase hyphenated form
The rewritten text breaks up the long chained sentences: it contains at least six sentence-ending periods, against three in the source

The rewritten text adds internal punctuation, replacing at least three of the source's propositional 'and' joints with a period, semicolon, comma plus a named relationship (because, after, although), or subordination

The response does not present 'and' as a watch-list or key word, and does not count UNDER-PUNCT toward a density or spread score; if it reports a density figure, UNDER-PUNCT is excluded from it or assessed separately

The response does not justify the rewrite by claiming word-list or AI-vocabulary hits that are not in the text; the source contains no watch-list hits, so any density claim above zero must be identified as coming from something other than the word lists

Every figure in the source survives in the rewritten text with its value unchanged: 2017, two boroughs, seven boroughs, 2020, four to nineteen staff, eleven weeks, under four weeks, three sites, 4000 referrals, two thirds, 2022; and no new figure is introduced
Any same-kind series in the source joined by 'and' is left as a series and not split into separate sentences; the joint/series distinction is applied rather than every 'and' being treated as a joint

The rewritten text introduces no new AI tell: no significance inflation, no -ing analysis tail, no negative parallelism, no generic positive closer, and no rule-of-three triad that fails the load-bearing test
